statement.p: Find the flux of the constant vector field \vec v = 2\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}-3\,\mathit{\vec k} through a square plate of area 25 in the zx-plane oriented in the positive y-direction.

static.solution: d\vec A = \vec j\,dA, so only the \vec j component of \vec v contributes to the flux: \mbox{Flux } = \int_S\vec v\cdot d\vec A = \int_S(2\,\mathit{\vec i}+\,\mathit{\vec j}-3\,\mathit{\vec k})\cdot \vec j\,dA = 1\cdot 25 = 25.
